13.t: Working with data: hearing range and age
q: Read the highest frequency heard at age 20.
The highest frequency heard falls with age, by about 2 kHz every 10 years.
Some shops play a 17 kHz tone to stop teenagers gathering. Use the graph to explain why it works.
People under about 25 can hear 17 kHz; most older adults cannot, so it annoys only young people.
Suggest a reason for the trend, and one way to protect hearing.
Hair cells in the cochlea are damaged over time and by loud noise, and do not grow back. Keep headphones quieter and use ear protection.
